fields.gap: Ground handling of a 4645 kg, 20 m vacuum sphere has no concept, cradle, or transport plan; core-safe pad pressure target is 250 kPa or less, and any handling dent is an imperfection feeding the already-severe 0.20 knockdown.

fields.effect: A dent below the survey threshold enters the buckling knockdown unmeasured.
